rules.note: Priest In Peril, varp 302 = 5: Talked to the real Drezel through the bars of his cell on the top floor. Source: Quest Helper (Zoinkwiz/quest-helper on GitHub, master as of 2025-10-23), PriestInPeril.java loadSteps: 5 = find the iron key, fill the bucket, open the cell (unverified)
rules.about: Said once, partway through Priest in Peril.
say: So that's the real Drezel. Then who were we talking to at the door?
A vampyre in a coffin, in a temple, upstairs. I'd like that noted twice.
Locked in his own temple. And the key's somewhere else, naturally.

rules.title: Priest in Peril: the coffin sealed
rules.note: Priest In Peril, varp 302 = 7: Poured the blessed water over the vampyre's coffin. Source: Quest Helper (Zoinkwiz/quest-helper on GitHub, master as of 2025-10-23), PriestInPeril.java loadSteps: 6 = bless the water and use it on the coffin, 7 = talk to Drezel again. The cache only shows the caged Drezel leaving at 9 (unverified)
rules.about: Said once, partway through Priest in Peril.
say: Sealed in. I'd still rather not stand next to it.
Holy water on a coffin. It's gone quiet, which I'm taking as a yes.
One vampyre, filed under contained. I'll check the lid on the way out.

rules.title: Priest in Peril: the coffin sealed (after Vampyre Slayer)
rules.note: Callback: said instead of qm-priest-in-peril-the-coffin-sealed when Vampyre Slayer is done. Priest In Peril, varp 302 = 7: Poured the blessed water over the vampyre's coffin. Source: Quest Helper (Zoinkwiz/quest-helper on GitHub, master as of 2025-10-23), PriestInPeril.java loadSteps: 6 = bless the water and use it on the coffin, 7 = talk to Drezel again. The cache only shows the caged Drezel leaving at 9 (unverified)
rules.about: Said once, partway through Priest in Peril, if you have already done Vampyre Slayer.
say: A vampyre in a coffin again. This one, at least, is staying in.

rules.title: Waterfall Quest: Hudon on his island
rules.note: Waterfall Quest, varp 65 = 2: Found Hudon on the island after the raft wrecked, and he refused to come home. Source: Quest Helper (Zoinkwiz/quest-helper on GitHub, master as of 2025-10-23), WaterfallQuest.java loadSteps: 1 = raft to Hudon and talk to him, 2 = go and read the book (unverified)
rules.about: Said once, partway through Waterfall Quest.
say: His mother will want a report. I'm drafting something gentle.

rules.title: Waterfall Quest: the book on Baxtorian
rules.note: Waterfall Quest, varp 65 = 3: Read the Book on Baxtorian upstairs in the Tourist Information Centre. Source: Quest Helper (Zoinkwiz/quest-helper on GitHub, master as of 2025-10-23), WaterfallQuest.java loadSteps: reading the book is the last action of value 2; 3 and 4 share the pebble-and-tomb step. That reading is what sets 3 is inferred (unverified)
rules.about: Said once, partway through Waterfall Quest.
say: An elf king, a lost queen and a pebble. I'll need more ink.
A pebble for a key, kept by gnomes for a century. Of course.
A very good book. I'll want to read it again, slower.

rules.title: Waterfall Quest: Golrie's pebble
rules.note: Waterfall Quest, varbit 9110 = 1: Golrie, let out of his cage, handed over Glarial's pebble. Source: Varbit 9110 is WATERFALL_GOLRIE_CHAT (RuneLite gameval; cache: varp 667 bit 14). Quest Helper commit fc4e126d43 (2025-04-10) read == 1 as 'got the pebble'; its 2025-08 polish switched to checking for the pebble item instead (unverified)
rules.about: Said once, partway through Waterfall Quest.
say: Old elven junk, he says. I'd have checked with an elf first.
He handed it over like a button off a coat.
A queen's pebble, in a gnome's pocket. It's had quite a century.

rules.title: Waterfall Quest: Golrie's pebble (after Tree Gnome Village)
rules.note: Callback: said instead of qm-waterfall-quest-golries-pebble when Tree Gnome Village is done. Waterfall Quest, varbit 9110 = 1: Golrie, let out of his cage, handed over Glarial's pebble. Source: Varbit 9110 is WATERFALL_GOLRIE_CHAT (RuneLite gameval; cache: varp 667 bit 14). Quest Helper commit fc4e126d43 (2025-04-10) read == 1 as 'got the pebble'; its 2025-08 polish switched to checking for the pebble item instead (unverified)
rules.about: Said once, partway through Waterfall Quest, if you have already done Tree Gnome Village.
say: We've been through that maze before. I didn't know it had a cellar.

rules.title: Waterfall Quest: Glarial's tomb
rules.note: Waterfall Quest, varp 65 = 1-9: Used the pebble on Glarial's tombstone and went down, unarmed. Source: Region 10137 worked out from Quest Helper's glarialTomb zone (x 2524-2557, y 9801-9849). The 1-9 range rests only on the cache end state, 10
rules.about: Said once, partway through Waterfall Quest.
say: Peaceful intent only, the stone said. I've never had any other kind.
Empty-handed in a tomb. I'm used to it, and you aren't.
A queen's tomb. I'm taking my hat off, figuratively.

rules.title: Waterfall Quest: behind the falls
rules.note: Waterfall Quest, varp 65 = 1-9: Went through the ledge door, wearing Glarial's amulet, into the Waterfall Dungeon. Source: Region 10394 worked out from Quest Helper's falls, endRoom and end2 zones (x 2556-2608, y 9861-9917). The 1-9 range rests only on the cache end state, 10
rules.about: Said once, partway through Waterfall Quest.
say: Behind the waterfall. Every story says there's something behind it.
It's dry in here. Somebody built this to stay dry.
The water let us in. I didn't think it would, and said nothing.
The report for Hudon's mother is getting harder to keep gentle.

rules.title: Waterfall Quest: the chalice room
rules.note: Waterfall Quest, varp 65 = 1-9: Walked into the northern cavern with the two statues and the floating Chalice of Eternity. Source: Area is Quest Helper's end2 zone, where its useUrnOnChalice step applies. The 1-9 range rests only on the cache end state, 10
rules.about: Said once, partway through Waterfall Quest.
say: A cup, floating, and nobody's mentioned it. I'm mentioning it.
Two statues and a cup in mid-air. I don't know where to start the page.
The air's very still in here. Even the cup's holding its breath.

rules.title: Witch's House: the mouse
rules.note: Witchs House, varp 226 = 3: Stuck the magnet on the mouse, which went home and unlocked the back door. Source: Quest Helper (Zoinkwiz/quest-helper on GitHub, master as of 2025-10-23), WitchsHouse.java loadSteps: ratHasMagnet is BALLQUEST >= 3 (unverified)
rules.about: Said once, partway through Witch's House.
say: Well done, mouse. You'll get a portrait.

rules.title: Witch's House: the garden
rules.note: Witchs House, varp 226 = 1-6: Stepped out of the back door into the witch's hedged garden. Source: Area from Quest Helper's garden1/garden2 zones, trimmed to leave out the house. The 1-6 range rests only on the cache end state, 7
rules.about: Said once, partway through Witch's House.
say: Hedges, a fountain and a witch on patrol. Quietly, then.
I'll write very softly from here.
Every step on this lawn sounds louder than it is.

rules.title: Witch's House: the experiment
rules.note: Witchs House, varp 226 = 1-6: Opened the shed and found the ball, with the witch's experiment beside it. Source: 'Witch's experiment' checked in the cache (npcs 3996, 6394); later shapes are '(second form)' to '(fourth form)', 3997-3999 and 6395-6397, all matched by the wildcard. The 1-6 range rests only on the cache end state, 7
rules.about: Said once, partway through Witch's House.
say: So that's the experiment. I'd hoped it was a vegetable.
The ball's on the crate. The thing beside it is not a crate.
That isn't a ball, and it's between us and the ball.

rules.title: Witch's House: the experiment (after Ernest the Chicken)
rules.note: Callback: said instead of qm-witchs-house-the-experiment when Ernest The Chicken is done. Witchs House, varp 226 = 1-6: Opened the shed and found the ball, with the witch's experiment beside it. Source: 'Witch's experiment' checked in the cache (npcs 3996, 6394); later shapes are '(second form)' to '(fourth form)', 3997-3999 and 6395-6397, all matched by the wildcard. The 1-6 range rests only on the cache end state, 7
rules.about: Said once, partway through Witch's House, if you have already done Ernest the Chicken.
say: Another experiment. Ernest only got turned into a chicken.
Ernest only got as far as a chicken. Whoever made this aimed higher.

rules.title: Witch's House: the experiment beaten
rules.note: Witchs House, varp 226 = 6: Beat the experiment's last shape in the shed. Source: Quest Helper (Zoinkwiz/quest-helper on GitHub, master as of 2025-10-23), WitchsHouse.java loadSteps: 6 = returnBall (pick up the ball, take it to the boy) (unverified)
rules.about: Said once, partway through Witch's House.

remember.as: the thing in the witch's shed
remember.plain: the thing in the witch's shed

say: That's the lot, I think. It kept coming back in new clothes.
Four of it, and the ball sat there through every one.
It's stopped. I'm giving it a moment to be sure.
That thing gets a whole page. The mouse only got a portrait.

rules.title: Witch's House: caught in the garden
rules.note: Witchs House, varp 226 = 1-6: The witch spotted the player in her garden, shouted and sent them out. Source: Shout text taken from the chronicle page ('Stop! Thief!'). Not confirmed that it arrives as an overhead NPC line rather than dialogue. The 1-6 range rests only on the cache end state, 7 (unverified)
rules.about: Said once, partway through Witch's House.
say: Caught. The notes will say we were admiring the hedges.
Out on our ear. I'll call that reconnaissance.
Thief is a strong word. Trespasser, I'll grant her.

rules.title: Children of the Sun: the bag
rules.note: Children Of The Sun, varbit 9632 = 6: The delegation has arrived, a guard has left the palace with a very large bag, and the player has decided to follow him. Source: Quest Helper ChildrenOfTheSun.java (6 = follow the guard); cache: Alina and Noah shown at 0-6, Sergeant Tobyn in the square from 6
rules.about: Said once, partway through Children of the Sun.

remember.as: the guard with the very large bag
remember.plain: the guard with the very large bag

say: The whole square watched the delegation. Noah watched the bag.
Supplies, he said. Supplies don't usually need a bag that size.
A kingdom opens its doors, and you follow a bag. I'm not complaining.

rules.title: Children of the Sun: the hideout
rules.note: Children Of The Sun, varbit 9632 = 8: The player tailed the guard unseen across south-east Varrock and he went into a small building beside Aubury's. Source: Quest Helper (8 = attempt to enter the house); cache: the bag guard and the four bandits exist only at value 8
rules.about: Said once, partway through Children of the Sun.
say: Not the gates, then.
He looked round every few steps. With that bag, so would I.
You kept out of sight. So did I, which is harder than it looks.

rules.title: Children of the Sun: the hideout (after Rune Mysteries)
rules.note: Callback: said instead of qm-children-of-the-sun-the-hideout when Rune Mysteries is done. Children Of The Sun, varbit 9632 = 8: The player tailed the guard unseen across south-east Varrock and he went into a small building beside Aubury's. Source: Quest Helper (8 = attempt to enter the house); cache: the bag guard and the four bandits exist only at value 8
rules.about: Said once, partway through Children of the Sun, if you have already done Rune Mysteries.
say: Next door to Aubury's. I hope nobody in there offers us tea.

rules.title: Children of the Sun: overheard
rules.note: Children Of The Sun, varbit 9632 = 10: The window cutscene has ended: four bandits with stolen uniforms plan to strike as the delegation leaves. The player means to tell the sergeant. Source: Quest Helper (10 = talk to Sergeant Tobyn); the cache agrees only that the bandits are gone after 8 (unverified)
rules.about: Said once, partway through Children of the Sun.
say: Stolen uniforms. I'm crossing out 'supplies'.
They all know the target. Nobody said it aloud, more's the pity.
I wrote every word down, and my hand's still shaking. Slightly.

rules.title: Children of the Sun: spot the four
rules.note: Children Of The Sun, varbit 9632 = 12: Sergeant Tobyn has heard the report, refused to warn the delegation, and sent the player to point out four bandits disguised as guards. Source: Quest Helper (12 = mark the guards, with per-guard varbits 9633-9644) (unverified)
rules.about: Said once, partway through Children of the Sun.
say: Four of these guards aren't. I'll be polite to all of them, to be safe.
No warning for the delegation, then. I'll panic quietly on their behalf.
Every guard in Varrock looks a bit off to me. That's no help, I know.

rules.title: Children of the Sun: the roof
rules.note: Children Of The Sun, varbit 9632 = 16: The four were arrested and Sergeant Tobyn has escorted the player up to the cell on the palace roof for the questioning. Source: Quest Helper (16 = go to the roof); cache: roof Tobyn and the caged bandit appear from 16; roof cell 3205,3471,2 is region 12854
rules.about: Said once, partway through Children of the Sun.
say: A cell on the palace roof. Out of the way, he said, and it certainly is.
Questioning. I'll stand at the back and take the minutes.
Four arrested, and nobody shouted. Varrock's guards at their best.

rules.title: Children of the Sun: the roof (after Priest in Peril)
rules.note: Callback: said instead of qm-children-of-the-sun-the-roof when Priest In Peril is done. Children Of The Sun, varbit 9632 = 16: The four were arrested and Sergeant Tobyn has escorted the player up to the cell on the palace roof for the questioning. Source: Quest Helper (16 = go to the roof); cache: roof Tobyn and the caged bandit appear from 16; roof cell 3205,3471,2 is region 12854
rules.about: Said once, partway through Children of the Sun, if you have already done Priest in Peril.
say: The palace again. Last time we were here, the King wanted your head.

rules.title: X Marks the Spot: the first hole
rules.note: X Marks The Spot, varbit 8063 = 3: Dug at the first spot, outside Bob's Brilliant Axes, and found the next clue: a map. Source: Quest Helper XMarksTheSpot.java (3 = dig behind the castle); the wiki transcript has the same four clue stages in the same order (unverified)
rules.about: Said once, partway through X Marks the Spot.
say: That's hole one. I've started numbering them, just in case.

rules.title: X Marks the Spot: the orb
rules.note: X Marks The Spot, varbit 8063 = 4: Dug at the X behind Lumbridge Castle, by the kitchen door, and found a mysterious orb. Source: Quest Helper (4 = dig in Draynor) (unverified)
rules.about: Said once, partway through X Marks the Spot.
say: An orb, buried behind a kitchen. I'd have looked for a ladle.
Scroll, map, now an orb. Whoever planned this liked variety.
A glass ball out of the ground. I'm keeping my hands in my pockets.

rules.title: X Marks the Spot: the orb (after Cook's Assistant)
rules.note: Callback: said instead of qm-x-marks-the-spot-the-orb when Cooks Assistant is done. X Marks The Spot, varbit 8063 = 4: Dug at the X behind Lumbridge Castle, by the kitchen door, and found a mysterious orb. Source: Quest Helper (4 = dig in Draynor) (unverified)
rules.about: Said once, partway through X Marks the Spot, if you have already done Cook's Assistant.
say: The cook's back door. If he sees us, he'll want something fetched.

rules.title: X Marks the Spot: the cipher
rules.note: X Marks The Spot, varbit 8063 = 5: Followed the orb to the spot east of Draynor, near the jail, and dug up a scroll written in cipher. Source: Quest Helper (5 = dig in the pig pen by Martin) (unverified)
rules.about: Said once, partway through X Marks the Spot.
say: Digging next to a jail. Bold, even for you.
Letters that don't spell anything. Yet.
I kept an eye on the jail guards while you dug. Someone had to.

rules.title: X Marks the Spot: the cipher (after Prince Ali Rescue)
rules.note: Callback: said instead of qm-x-marks-the-spot-the-cipher when Prince Ali Rescue is done. X Marks The Spot, varbit 8063 = 5: Followed the orb to the spot east of Draynor, near the jail, and dug up a scroll written in cipher. Source: Quest Helper (5 = dig in the pig pen by Martin) (unverified)
rules.about: Said once, partway through X Marks the Spot, if you have already done Prince Ali Rescue.
say: That's the jail we got Prince Ali out of. I'd rather not go back in.

rules.title: X Marks the Spot: the casket
rules.note: X Marks The Spot, varbit 8063 = 6: Dug up the ancient casket in the Draynor pig pen, heard a faint whisper, and put it down to the wind. Source: Quest Helper (6 = bring Veos the casket) (unverified)
rules.about: Said once, partway through X Marks the Spot.

remember.as: the whispering casket in the pig pen
remember.plain: the whispering casket in the pig pen

say: A whispering casket. I'm holding the notebook a little further away.
Whatever that was, the pigs are keeping it to themselves.
Buried in a pig pen. Whoever hid it didn't want visitors.
Hole four, by my count, and the only one that whispered.

rules.title: Client of Kourend: the burning quill
rules.note: Client Of Kourend, varbit 5621 = 1: Finished Regath's interview in Arceuus; when he spoke of the Dark Altar the quill and scroll glowed and burned the player's hand. Source: Quest Helper ClientOfKourend.java (talkedToRegath = varbit 5621 at 1); cache gameval names 5620-5624 VEOS_PISCARILIUS / _ARCEUUS / _LOVAKENGJ / _SHAYZIEN / _HOSIDIUS (unverified)
rules.about: Said once, partway through Client of Kourend.
say: My quill has never once done that. I checked it anyway.

rules.title: Client of Kourend: the whisper
rules.note: Client Of Kourend, varbit 5619 = 2: Finished the fifth city's interview and heard a whisper: 'Return to Veos...'. Source: Quest Helper (2 = return to Veos, after all five store owners) (unverified)
rules.about: Said once, partway through Client of Kourend.
say: A voice in your ear, you say. I heard nothing, and I was right here.
Five cities written up, and the scroll's still blank. I'd want a receipt.
Return to Veos, it said. Not please, I notice.

rules.title: Client of Kourend: the orb
rules.note: Client Of Kourend, varbit 5619 = 4: Back with Veos: he took the scroll and quill, passed on the client's apology for the burn, and handed over an orb to activate by the Dark Altar. Source: Quest Helper (4 = take the orb to the altar; 3 is also 'return to Veos', so 3 is probably set inside that same conversation) (unverified)
rules.about: Said once, partway through Client of Kourend.
say: An orb, for an altar, for a client. I'd like one name in all that.
Best you don't ask, he says. I've written the question down anyway.
The last task, they assure him. Everyone says that.

rules.title: Client of Kourend: the Dark Altar
rules.note: Client Of Kourend, varbit 5619 = 4: Arrived at the Dark Altar, north of Arceuus, carrying the orb. Source: Quest Helper (4); region 6716 from the cache map label 'Dark Altar' at 1696,3880 and the chronicle's audited dark-altar sketch (unverified)
rules.about: Said once, partway through Client of Kourend.
say: This is near enough for me. You go on.
So this is what upset the scroll.
I'll take my notes from here, where the light's better. It isn't.
My quill's staying in my pocket here. It's behaved so far.

rules.title: Client of Kourend: the Dark Altar (after Priest in Peril)
rules.note: Callback: said instead of qm-client-of-kourend-dark-altar when Priest In Peril is done. Client Of Kourend, varbit 5619 = 4: Arrived at the Dark Altar, north of Arceuus, carrying the orb. Source: Quest Helper (4); region 6716 from the cache map label 'Dark Altar' at 1696,3880 and the chronicle's audited dark-altar sketch (unverified)
rules.about: Said once, partway through Client of Kourend, if you have already done Priest in Peril.
say: I've stood by a vampyre's coffin for you. This is worse.
A vampyre's coffin was one thing. Here my quill stays pocketed.

rules.title: Client of Kourend: the orb shatters
rules.note: Client Of Kourend, varbit 5619 = 5: Activated the orb beside the Dark Altar; it shattered and a whisper said 'Return... to Veos. My thanks...'. Source: Quest Helper (5 = finish the quest with Veos) (unverified)
rules.about: Said once, partway through Client of Kourend.

remember.as: the orb breaking at the Dark Altar
remember.plain: the orb breaking at the Dark Altar

say: It thanked you. I'd rather it hadn't.
Glass everywhere, and a thank-you from nobody in particular.
Polite, at least. I'm not sure that helps.
